title: Project Afriat: Moral Geometry, Hourglass Sparsity, and Orthogonal Procrustes Mid-Stack Recurrence in Gemma 4 31B
description:
Complete codebase, lexical-firewalled evaluation suites, SHA-256-locked experimental JSON outputs, and full-text PDF monographs for Project Afriat:

  • Part 1 (Inside the Weights, Money Is Moral): Non-financial moral directions (Spite, Guilt, Contamination, Predation, Vastness) calibrated strictly on 200 money-free stories causally steer dollar reservation prices across 920 emotion-free contracts in Gemma 4 31B, Gemma 4 12B, and Phi-4 14B while getting scrubbed from public rationales.
  • Part 2 (Rotating the Bottleneck): Read/write MLP funnel dissection across Layers 24 to 42 in Gemma 4 31B, rotating 3D moral subspace clamping (-68.8% covert multi-turn retaliation), Hourglass INT4/INT8 compression onto one 24 GB GPU (62.55 GB to 23.08 GB), and closed-form SVD Orthogonal Procrustes mid-stack recurrence across an 87.1-degree coordinate turn (lifting silent 0-CoT multi-hop accuracy from 0.8% to 25.8%).
